name: Jobs for Youth (County of San Mateo)
org: County of San Mateo Human Resources
what_you_do: Free job-skills workshops, a members-only job and internship board, and twenty $2,000 scholarships a year for San Mateo County youth. The county summer internship is for ages 18 to 21.
who_can_apply: San Mateo County youth ages 14 to 21 can join. The county summer internship is only for members ages 18 to 21. You must attend a 1 hour job prep workshop before using the job board.
pay_detail: Workshops and job board are free. Twenty $2,000 scholarships each year. Pay for the county summer internship is not stated on the pages I read.
duration: County summer internship: June to August, about 8 to 10 weeks, 20 to 40 hours a week
deadline_text: Membership: register any time. Summer internship: 2026 applications are closed; the page says next summer opens early 2027 (no date posted). Scholarship deadline not stated.
how_to_apply: Register as a student member on jobsforyouth.org, attend the 1 hour job prep workshop, then use the job board. For the internship you also attend a mandatory orientation.
notes: Teens under 18 can use the workshops and job board but not the county internship. Phone 650-599-7215, email jobsforyouth@smcgov.org. Must be a San Mateo County resident for the internship.
